notes.title: Camera Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018927/b73f79d4138757973534d964dc004c008acd1663.png[/img]You can now find new camera lens object on table. It allows to change camera lens between [b]original cinematic lens[/b] and [b]new wide angle lens[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018927/7d20bc90e31dd54a23aec24b20b58a833abf5005.png[/img]
Some users found to be not quite used to the camera view originally introduced in the game, it is simulating cinematic lens which is not very common in first person games yet creating an authentic camera look.
You can now switch to new lens, which has a wider view and works like a camera you would expect in first person game.

Other improvements include [b]smoother camera[/b] movement and [b]wider camera bounds[/b], which means no more clipping into the girl or occasional "jump scare" effect.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
This update introduces some important bugfixes which includes:
[list]
[*] Pause menu fix
[*] Game progression fix
[*] Sounds improvements
[/list]

Appearing for a number of new users "pause bug" was preventing quitting the game easily, while progression inconsistency was opening the whole action tree from the start making the game a bit shorter than it should be. 

Your feedback is valuable, don't hesitate to open a discussion if you see a way for improvement.
More updates (real ones, not just fixes) are on the way, stay tuned.

P.S. For those asking, more girls are already in development.
